name: Certain Topics
overview: Scripture encourages believers to place unwavering trust in the LORD, relying not on their own understanding but on God's faithful presence and guidance. Passages such as Deuteronomy 31:6 and Joshua 1:9 emphasize courage and confidence because God goes with His people and will never forsake them. This trust leads to renewed strength and endurance as described in Isaiah 40:31, while Jeremiah 29:11 reveals God's intentions for peace and hope for the future. Prioritizing God's kingdom and righteousness, as taught in Matthew 6:33, ensures that all other needs will be provided.
